cpu_configuration.scope: One method at a time on the same CPU host. No CPU affinity is imposed. CPU seconds sum user and system time over threads and completed worker/compiler processes; CPU seconds / wall seconds is average CPU utilization, not a core-count limit.

physical_configuration.description: Synthetic finite-source stellar event inspired by OGLE-2007-BLG-050
physical_configuration.observer: Earth geocenter; the bundled heliocentric Earth ephemeris, without terrestrial parallax
physical_configuration.observing_scope: Idealized longitude-distributed ground network over one bulge season, with continuous peak follow-up; weather and site visibility are not simulated
physical_configuration.exposure_scope: Fixed pre-injection point-source forecast: clip(60/A_forecast, 1, 60) seconds; top-hat averages
physical_configuration.detector_scope: Illustrative detector and seeing-spread PSF; not an instrument ETC or survey forecast. Apparent source brightness is specified independently of its angular radius
physical_configuration.noise_scope: Known independent Gaussian errors from injected source+blend photons, sky, aperture read variance, and an independent 0.3% fractional floor; recomputed for each scheduled exposure
physical_configuration.blend_scope: Unresolved constant light; source and blend coefficients share a normalized Gaussian prior and are sampled jointly
physical_configuration.limb_darkening: Inferred linear a1 with logit(a1)~Normal(0,1); injected a1=0.5 is an illustrative I-band profile. The actual inspiration event also fitted limb darkening (Batista et al. 2009, Section 3.1); its Gamma coefficient uses a different convention

flux_treatment: joint; source and blend fluxes sampled, no marginalization
ess_estimator: emcee.autocorr.integrated_time(c=5, tol=0) on unthinned physical-parameter series; ESS=N/tau. Walkers in each ensemble are correlated; independent-ensemble agreement is checked separately.
branch: u0 > 0; conditional sampling of one parallax solution

configuration.outside_domain: NaN; rho=0 uses the analytic point-source limit

generation.provenance: Copied unchanged from the independently validated astrometry_methods_table_192.npz; no regeneration during packaging

interface.abi_check: 5.x header, binary and table verified against same distribution RECORD
interface.build_cache: once per process; fresh temporary build

interface.abi_check: 5.x header, binary and table verified against same distribution RECORD
interface.build_cache: once per process; fresh temporary build

parallel_execution.scope: Independent VBM instances in separate processes; no concurrent calls to its static scratch state. Batches are returned in their input order.

cache_reuse.scope: Identical numerical injection, geometry, and detector. Only the flux-inference description changed from marginalized to joint; source quadrature hashes and numeric payload remain identical.

saturation.scope: Illustrative detector, fixed scheduled exposures, and seeing-spread peak pixel; excludes sky saturation

scope: singlens Table/NumPyro NUTS versus VBMicrolensing/emcee. Same observations, jointly sampled Gaussian-prior source/blend fluxes, priors, exposure nodes, and Table MAP/Hessian affine coordinates. Numerical lens approximations differ. This compares complete inference implementations, changing both finite-source solver and sampler. Total time includes common model/MAP/Hessian initialization, each backend setup (including the VBM array bridge), compilation, warmup, and sampling. Independent injection, diagnostic checks, signed-mode audit, posterior selection, IO, and figures are excluded and are not inferred from kernel timings. Sampling is conditional on u0>0; no claim of global traversal between parallax modes.
posterior_agreement_scope: Mean differences scaled by pooled posterior SD and combined estimated MCSE; describes numerical-target differences as well as Monte Carlo error; not a sampler convergence gate or calibrated significance test. Both algorithms use the same integer seed but different random-number streams.

mode_audit.scope: Three dispersed parallax starts per sign of u0; local MAP searches do not prove global mode completeness. Sampler timings condition on the positive-u0 branch. Both samplers share its MAP and exact joint Hessian.
mode_audit.criterion: Finite objective and gradient; max absolute least-squares-scaled gradient <1e-5; positive-definite joint Hessian
mode_audit.laplace_scope: Local Gaussian volume estimate with equal prior probabilities for the two signs; not a measured mode probability or an MCMC mixing diagnostic.

gradient_check.scope: Exact joint target in the shared MAP/Hessian affine coordinates; every coordinate direction and one mixed direction, at the MAP and a nonstationary offset. Evaluated outside sampler timers.
gradient_check.method: Central differences with five halved steps; fourth-order Richardson extrapolation from adjacent steps. Both AD agreement and final refinement must pass.
gradient_check.scale: max(1, abs(AD directional derivative), abs(finest Richardson derivative))

table.scope: Peak, both contacts and wings at 25 observed epochs per state. Independent spatial quadrature checks the first two supplied states (truth and MAP); 3/9/15-node exposure averaging checks every supplied state. This is a sampled validation, not a uniform error bound.

vbm.scope: Native VBM settings; numerical approximation errors are measured, not forced to match Table accuracy. Interface and finite-exposure correctness are checked separately.
